spans.s:
styāna
(‘langour’)
------------------------------------------
The Yogasūtras of पतञ्जलि (200 B. C.) lists nine अन्तरायस् or obstacles to योग (1.30). स्त्यान (apathy or langour) is the second of such obstacles. It is mental laziness and has to be overcome by great will power and self-effort.
